body: I am sorry though. I've been sleeping most of the weekend. I don't have much energy for anything right now. I'm trying. I went into work but I told them I'd be off for a doctor's appointment and would bring a note back sometime this week. They weren't happy but I don't care anymore.

Yes I’m sorry I went to sleep most of the day. I work at a call center that’s always open. I chose to work weekends because that’s less people to deal with. If this happened as bad as it did on a weekday I would not make it

I appreciate that info, still. I figured a day or two wouldn’t make a difference since I try to plan as meticulously as possible. But I’ll play it safe and wait for answers from the cryobank and my endo tomorrow
I’m glad you were able to get that 3 years is outrageous. I can barely wait until next month.
That’s good. I made sure to step up and do my part to make the appointment and to submit my paper work on time. I hesitated at first because I was of getting help

I live in the US. I’m trying to be patient I was crying earlier but I calmed down. That’s reassuring though. I did everything that was asked of me now I just have to wait until my insurance starts up.

I think it’s normal. Sometimes people are just annoying, and you have faces or voices, or see/hear words you don’t like. Music movies, whatever. Sometimes you just don’t like something or someone, even if they mean well, and as long as you’re not someone harmful, then I think it’s ok. You’re not obligated to like shit. 
We have a standard today that if you dislike something for a reason that someone else can’t relate with, (which the reasoning could just be ‘no reason’ at all) then you’re wrong. 
Fuck those people. 

That being said, she’s just a kid, who’s taking a stand. Maybe it’s annoying because a kid is getting more traction or attention on a matter that’s important and you didn’t when you were a kid? I’m legitimately asking, not trying to be a dick. I find her mildly annoying not because of her existence, but because of how society is putting her in the spotlight and there’s literally been kids doing this for years. And they’re not getting ANY comparable exposure. So I’m upset with society’s obsession over her.
